verdict.rationale: The docs define a skill spec (a directory with SKILL.md requiring name and description), a built-in skill creator that interviews the user about triggers and scripts, and a recorder that drafts skills from demonstrations. The `@plugin-creator` meta-skill scaffolds the plugin.json manifest, MCP wiring and a local marketplace entry, and docs describe packaging and ZIP submission. A community user reports building proprietary skills with skill-creator, and a probe installed the plugin-creator skill as a valid portable folder. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of an agent completing a full author-to-package run with the meta-skill (the probe only verified installation, not authoring).
